question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Fierce
solution:
The correct answer is: **Aggressive**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fierce **means having a violent or aggressive nature. (हिंसक या आक्रामक स्वभाव वाला)

 
 
• **For example- ***The tiger's gaze was fierce.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Aggressive **means ready or likely to attack or confront. (हमला करने या मुकाबला करने के लिए तैयार या संभावित)
 
 
• **For example- ***The dog's behaviour became aggressive.*
 
 
 
• From here, it is clear that the most appropriate **synonym **for 'Fierce' is 'Aggressive.'

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Fraud**: Wrongful or criminal deception intended to result in financial or personal gain. (गलत या आपराधिक धोखे का उद्देश्य वित्तीय या व्यक्तिगत लाभ प्राप्त करना है)
